feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: British student pilot among three killed in mid-air helicopter crash in US
articles.summary: Three people have been killed in a mid-air collision between two helicopters near a small airport in Oregon, police said.

articles.title: Star Trek and X-Men actor Sir Patrick Stewart dies
articles.summary: Star Trek and X-Men actor Sir Patrick Stewart has died after a "brief and poignant journey" with Alzheimer's and dementia.

articles.title: Met refers itself to police watchdog over handling of letter about Meghan's father
articles.summary: The Metropolitan Police has referred itself to the Independent Office for Police Conduct (IOPC) over a letter containing allegations about the Duchess of Sussex's father, Thomas Markle Snr.

articles.title: Former church leader and wife charged with eight counts of rape
articles.summary: A former church leader and his wife have been charged with rape.

articles.title: Lead, mercury and nicotine found in seized fake cosmetics
articles.summary: Seized counterfeit cosmetics have been found to contain lead, mercury and other potentially harmful substances - and are getting more common.

articles.title: Leaflets promoting clinics in illegal Israeli settlements handed out at London medical recruitment event
articles.summary: Sky News has obtained copies of leaflets promoting medical clinics in illegal Israeli settlements by a company seeking to recruit British Jewish doctors at an event in London

articles.title: Manosphere as bad as tobacco in terms of harm, report warns
articles.summary: Social media "manosphere" communities should be treated as a public health issue, a new report says - comparing them to the tobacco industry.

articles.title: Knifeman on train had 'greatest delight on his face', court told
articles.summary: A man who stabbed 10 people on a London-bound train "had the greatest delight on his face" and was "loving every single moment" of the attack, a court has heard.

articles.title: Trump warned $10bn BBC lawsuit could be dismissed
articles.summary: Donald Trump's $10bn (£7.5bn) defamation lawsuit against the BBC could be dismissed unless he turns over documents requested by the broadcaster, a US court has warned.

articles.title: Poundland closer to collapse as it files notice to appoint administrators
articles.summary: Poundland has filed notice to appoint administrators, bringing it one step closer to collapse.
